defect: Canonical size was checked only after allocating the entire output. Namespace fanout makes input bounds insufficient. No process exhaustion experiment or external vulnerability claim.

owned_reproduction.boundary: Owned canonicalizer experiment, not a signed trusted-list document or an external finding. Tracemalloc excludes native allocations.

review_depth.lxml_api: Selected ElementTree.write C14N API and local pinned lxml 6.1.3 docstring. Exclusive C14N 1.0 without comments, not C14N 2.0. Actual callback abortion measured on both runtimes.
review_depth.w3c: 2013-04-11 Working Group Note, sections on verification ordering and costly namespace/transform work. No XPath transform is admitted here; the owned example measures exclusive C14N namespace repetition.

development_observations: Initial added-control run: 68 passed, 2 failed because default ASCII fixture serialization emitted invalid character references inside a non-ASCII namespace prefix. Explicit UTF-8 fixture serialization fixed both without changing parser policy.
First private real-source replay script failed on both runtimes by unpacking the three-value parse result as two values. Corrected the helper; final reports match the retained baseline exactly.
claim_boundaries: Writer cap limits retained canonical bytes; parser/native writer allocations and final bounded copy are additional. No total process-memory or CPU guarantee.
Namespace ceilings are explicit subset restrictions and can refuse valid XML.
Both document mathematics reports are unchanged; publication bootstrap assumptions and missing currentness/native admission remain.
